image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tabby cat sleeping with its head resting on the edge of an open book. The cat's eyes are closed, and its face is pressed against the pages. The fur shows distinct brown and black tabby markings. A small portion of a white paw is visible in the bottom left corner.
